Jimmy is at 4 VP, so the game is almost over. I need to keep my Ore to have any chance of getting to 3 Ore for a city. However, Gemma's message suggests she wants to cooperate against Jimmy. But practically, giving up my only Ore when it's so hard for me to get (only on a 3) is too risky. I'll reject and try to negotiate or wait for a better roll.
